query: I'm about to start working on the new notification system. Can you set up a feature branch and worktree so I have an isolated workspace? I don't want to mess up my current working tree since I have uncommitted changes.
I've been working on feature/auth-redesign for 3 days and it's ready. Can you help me merge it back into main? I want to squash the 14 commits into something clean first, then create a PR.
Set up a worktree for me in ../payment-refactor so I can work on the payment module rewrite in isolation while keeping my current branch untouched. Branch it off the latest main.
I'm done with this branch and the changes have been merged upstream. Can you clean up — delete the local branch, remove the worktree if there is one, and make sure everything is tidy?
I need to start implementing the search feature. Create a new branch called feature/full-text-search from main, push it to origin, and set up tracking so I can start committing.

I've got 6 files changed across 3 different concerns — some are bugfixes, some are the new feature, and one is a config change. Help me create 3 separate atomic commits with proper conventional commit messages grouping related changes.
Can you create a pull request for my current branch? It's the caching implementation we discussed. Include a summary of all the commits since we branched from main and list the files changed.
I want to preserve this experimental branch — it didn't work out for production but has useful prototyping code. Tag it or archive it somehow before we delete the branch so we can reference it later.
finish this branch up — the feature is complete, tests pass, I just need you to handle the git side. Make a final commit with any remaining changes, push, and open a PR against main.
I need to work on 2 features in parallel without them interfering. Set up worktrees for both feature/api-v3 and feature/dashboard-redesign branched off main, each in their own directory.
Can you look at the git history for src/auth/ and tell me when the OAuth implementation was added and who wrote it? I need to understand the context before making changes.
Help me resolve these merge conflicts in package.json and src/config.ts. Both branches modified the same sections and I need to keep changes from both sides.
Can you check what changed between v2.1.0 and v2.2.0? I need a diff summary to understand what broke our integration tests after upgrading.
Write a git hook that runs our linter and type checker before every commit. If either fails, the commit should be rejected with a helpful error message.
I accidentally committed a .env file with API keys 3 commits ago. Can you help me remove it from the entire git history using filter-branch or BFG? We need to scrub it completely.
Set up our .gitignore properly — we keep accidentally committing node_modules, .DS_Store, build artifacts, and coverage reports. Also add patterns for our IDE configs.
Can you revert commit abc123f? It introduced a regression in the payment flow and we need to undo it without losing the commits that came after it.
Help me configure git-crypt for this repo so that files in secrets/ are encrypted at rest. I need to set up the GPG keys for our 3 team members who should have access.
Bisect the test failure — tests were green on tag v3.0.0 and red on HEAD. There are about 40 commits between them. Use git bisect to find which commit introduced the regression.
Can you cherry-pick commits def456 and ghi789 from the feature branch onto our release/2.5 branch? We need just those two bugfixes without the rest of the feature work.
